l1: Wide symmetrical frontal. Smooth dolly pushes in on the news desk. Level, bright TV key light.
l2: Business as usual at Ežys news. The headline is anything but.
audio: RITA: In the news today: Pinocchio has entered his teens.

l1: Medium close on Benas. Locked off with a slow creep in. Clean studio key, soft rim.
l2: Total professional. He hands over to the most awkward live report of the year.
audio: BENAS: Trying to make contact: Andrius.

l1: Handheld over Andrius's shoulder. He knocks on a closed bedroom door with a NOBODY ENTERS sign.
l2: A real news crew at a real kid's door. Nobody is going to answer.

l1: Handheld close on the door gap. The door cracks open and the wooden nose slides out first.
l2: The problem enters the frame before he does.

l1: Camera pulls back as the door opens wider. Pinocchio's face appears, mic pushed in from frame left.
l2: Twelve, furious and wooden. He did not ask for this interview.

l1: Handheld medium, slightly high. Pinocchio on the sofa, mic from frame right, Christmas tree behind him.
l2: A confession on live TV. The tree stands there, innocent, waiting.
audio: PINOCCHIO: The holidays are almost here, and look what just grew on my nose!

l1: Close profile at nose height. His hands tie a string from the mandarin stem to the door handle.
l2: The oldest trick from childhood, applied to a very teenage problem.
audio: PINOCCHIO (VO): I tried to pull it off…

l1: Wide, static. He slams the door. The string snaps tight and yanks him face first into it.
l2: Physics wins. The mandarin doesn't move an inch.

l1: Wide handheld down a Lithuanian school corridor. A nose and mandarin poke out between hanging winter coats.
l2: The perfect hiding place. Almost. Here she comes.

l1: Tight close up through the gap between two coats. Eyes, nose and mandarin only.
l2: Teenage horror in its purest form. She has seen it.

l1: Handheld two shot. Andrius kindly holds out a mandarin to Pinocchio. Tree between them in the background.
l2: A small act of kindness. The worst possible move.

l1: Handheld low angle, 24mm. Pinocchio erupts and the nose shoots toward the lens. [VFX]
l2: Pure teenage rage. Every lie makes it longer.
audio: PINOCCHIO: I hate it! I hate Christmas! I hate mandarins! I hate, hate, hate them!

l1: Wide handheld. The nose hits the Christmas tree. Tree topples, Pinocchio falls back over the sofa. [VFX]
Wide at waist height. Andrius beside the nose rising vertically from the bottom edge of frame. [VFX]
l2: Pinocchio is on the floor out of shot, still ranting. The nose is not done.

l1: Same frame, camera holds. Leafy branches sprout along the nose into a Christmas tree full of mandarins. [VFX]
l2: In with the new one. Puberty, but make it festive.

l1: Handheld medium. Andrius picks a mandarin from the nose tree and turns to camera.
l2: The reporter has seen everything. Nothing surprises him anymore.
audio: ANDRIUS: Easy, Christmas is practically on our nose!

l1: Product shot at table height. Mandarins tumble in, a Lynxmonade bottle drops and smashes them. [CGI]
l2: Juice everywhere. The only explosion Christmas really needs.
audio: RITA (VO): Where there's Christmas, there are mandarins! Order the Ežys plan and win mandarin Ežys lemonade!

l1: Ežys logo on brand teal.
Top shot straight down into a toilet cubicle. He curls up on the lid, nose pointing at the lens.
l2: Alternative to the cloakroom. The cubicle is too narrow for his nose.

l1: Wide handheld from the side. A nose with a mandarin sticks out over the top of the second cubicle.
l2: Two boys at the sinks freeze. One of them reaches for his phone.
